summary.text: Jim Libby, a Republican, represents Maine Senate District 22, which covers Baldwin, Naples, Sebago and Standish in Cumberland County; Hiram and Porter in Oxford County; and Acton, Cornish, Limerick, Limington, Newfield, Parsonsfield and Shapleigh in York County. The Maine Legislature's profile lists committee assignments to Education and Cultural Affairs and Senate Conduct and Ethics.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists legislative service as Senate 118-119 and 131-132 and House 116-117.
